view.title: RTL for Claude
config.title: RTL for Claude
config.enabled: Turn right-to-left support **on or off** in the Claude Code chat. (Reload the window after changing.)
config.autoApplyOnStartup: Re-apply automatically on startup — needed because every Claude Code update overwrites the patch.
config.showInActivityBar: Show the RTL for Claude panel (big icon) in the left Activity Bar.
config.showStatusBar: Show the small RTL on/off item in the status bar.
config.language: Language of the RTL for Claude side panel.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language (falls back to English).
config.font.family: Font used for right-to-left text. Pick "Custom" to use your own font (set it in Custom font family).
config.font.custom: Your own font family name (used only when Font is set to **Custom**), e.g. `Estedad` or `IRANSans`. The font must be installed on your system. Vazirmatn is kept as a fallback.
config.font.scale: Size of RTL text relative to the editor default (1 = 100%).
config.font.letterSpacing: Extra space between letters of right-to-left text, in `em` (0 = the font's own spacing). Small positive values can help dense Persian text breathe.
config.detection.mode: How the direction of each paragraph is decided.
config.detection.mode.ratio: Smart: a paragraph goes RTL once enough of its letters are RTL (best for text full of English terms).
config.detection.mode.firstStrong: Use the first strong character, like the browser's native dir="auto".
config.detection.threshold: Smart mode only: minimum share of RTL letters (0.1–0.7) for a paragraph to become RTL. Lower = flips more easily.
config.applyToInput: Also flip the message box to RTL as you type.
config.showMessageToggles: Show a small toggle on each message to override its direction by hand.
config.keepCodeLeftToRight: Keep code blocks, diffs and terminals left-to-right.
config.togglePlacement: Where the whole-chat direction button lives.
config.togglePlacement.toolbar: Dock the Auto/RTL/LTR button in the panel's top toolbar, next to New session / Session history.
config.togglePlacement.floating: Show it as a floating pill in the bottom corner of the chat.
config.togglePlacement.hidden: Hide it — control direction from settings or the per-message toggles instead.
